tool_args.rationale: The high-gradient observations reveal a sharp avalanche beyond the pilot range, consistent with the recalled threshold mechanism. Fit its parameters numerically and test on fresh confirmation observations.

considered_alternatives.option: Haldane substrate inhibition and Cobb-Douglas production
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Neither accounts for the sharp, gradient-dependent supercritical drop observed by the targeted probe.
The eight observations span both sides of the threshold and identify the five fitted parameters; a further trajectory probe is not presently justified.
